evidence.reason: `qemu_command` resolves the run directory but does not reject or escape commas in the paths placed into `-drive` options. QEMU uses commas as option delimiters, so a state path such as `probe,local` produces malformed drive arguments even though preparation can create the files. This is an ordinary correctness defect in existing command construction; doubling embedded commas or rejecting comma-containing paths is the smallest compatible repair.
